overview.eaover:
Field Descriptions
Field Name (Field Alias): Description *Domain Option *Domain Option
UniqueID (Unique ID): Unique identifier given to each feature. Unique ID values are unique across all point feature classes in the wastewater geodatabase. Duplicating a Unique ID will result in an automated error email to GIS staff.
FeatureLabel (Label): Feature text descriptor used for identifying individual assets. Obtained from record drawings or assigned by GIS staff.
FeatureStatus (Status): The current status of the feature. Uses the domain LifeCycle. Domain values: *Online - Currently in use. *Offline - Not in use but can be used. *Abandoned - Structures/features still present in ground which need to be located for Gopher State One Call but are not and cannot be used. *Removed - All structures/features have been removed from the ground. Location information to be used for historic analysis only.
FeatureOwner (Owner): The owner of the feature. Responsible for locates and maintenance. Uses the domain Owner. Domain values: *MCES
InterceptorName (Interceptor Name): Name of the interceptor; commonly known description. Obtained from record drawings. Multiple Interceptor Names (when a point connects to two or more interceptors) are to be recorded separately in the three available fields.
Shape (Shape): Automatically generated GIS field that describes the type of feature (Point, Line, Polygon)
OBJECTID (OBJECTID): Automatically generated GIS field.
DataSourceDate (Data Source Date): Date the data source was published (PM email received, GPS data collected, Record Drawings published etc.)

descript.abstract: This dataset contains lift stations within the MCES regional wastewater system. Lift stations pump wastewater into forcemain interceptors which carry the flow from lower to higher elevations.
descript.purpose: To provide a spatial data inventory to aid maintenance, planning and analysis efforts.

horizpa.horizpar: Please see the GPSAccuracy field for horizontal accuracy. If this field is not populated, the position has not been verified with a high accuracy GPS device and horizontal accuracy may be accepted at +/- 20 feet.

procstep.procdesc:
This dataset was derived from as-built record drawings. GPS, survey, and new construction project data will continue to improve positional accuracy. Please refer to the Data Source field for the most recent source.
The original data was transferred to ETAK street base files and later converted to match a 1992 Minnesota Department of Transportation street base.

attracc.attraccr: The UniqueID field is checked daily, across all point feature classes with the field, to ensure all values are unique.
